UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
Order under Section 25A

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education having obtained a report under section 70C of the aforesaid Act, in respect of "Sri Lanka Institute of Textile and Apparel", established by the Sri Lanka Institute of Textile and Apparel Act, No. 12 of 2009 and located at Kandawala Estate, No. 02, General Sri John Kotalawala Mawatha, Ratmalana, do by this Order subject to such conditions specified in Schedule I hereto, recognize "Sri Lanka Institute of Textile and Apparel" as a Degree Awarding Institute for the purpose of developing Higher Education therein, leading to the award of the Degree specified in Column I of the Schedule II hereto, of which the abbreviation is set out in the corresponding entry in Column II of the Schedule II hereto:-
SCHEDULE I
Conditions

1. Sri Lanka Institute of Textile and Apparel (hereinafter referred to as "institute") shall, when admitting students for the degree programme specified in Schedule II hereto in respect of the Bachelor of Science in Textile and Apparel Studies with a minimum of 90 credits (SLQF Level 5), adhere to the minimum entry qualification of;

(a) At least three (3) simple passes (S) in any stream in one and the same sitting at the GCE Advanced Level Examination conducted by the Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka or equivalent qualification And

(b) At least Credit (C) pass in Mathematics and Science not exceeding two sittings in the GCE Ordinary Level Examination conducted by the Department of Examinations of Sri Lanka or equivalent qualification
2. The Institute shall conduct the degree programme specified in Schedule II hereto, only at Kandawala Estate, No. 02, General Sir John Kotalawala Mawatha, Ratmalana.

3. The Institute is recognized to offer the Degree specified in Schedule II hereto, subject to a review conducted by the Specified Authority every five (5) years from the date of publication of this Order.
